notes: The menu is drawn above the composer; the highlighted item starts with "› " on a coloured background; Tab completes. /help is not a Codex command (no menu). Isolated: CODEX_HOME scratch, fake provider 127.0.0.1:9. States frame-* (captured 2026-10-02): at 98x24, Gluon's frame interior on a 100x30 terminal (their "size"), in Gluon's screen model answering OSC 10/11 as a dark terminal (frame-plain-*: unanswered, as under a terminal that doesn't say: no shading); codex launched as Gluon launches it (-m gpt-6-luna -c model_reasoning_effort="low" -- <prompt>), the turn never reaching the provider ("Reconnecting..."): frame-working-* typed while it runs, frame-turn-* after Esc interrupted it. Each key typed after the previous one's echo: codex reads keys arriving together as a paste. Codex's managed app-server daemon (in the scratch CODEX_HOME) updated itself to 0.160.0 during that capture; the TUI drawing these screens is 0.159.3. States frame-folder-trust, frame-hook-*, frame-approve-*, frame-plan-question*, frame-model-picker (captured 2026-10-04, issue #40): Codex's own screens that wait for the user to pick, with no composer (a question's notes box has a `› ` row but no composer). Taken with tmux `capture-pane -e -p` in a 98x24 window (the frame's interior), fed through Gluon's screen model; tmux answers no OSC 11, so no shading (as frame-plain-*). Launched with Gluon's hook set (`CODEX_HOOK_ARGS`, GLUON_EVENTS and GLUON_SELF set), scratch CODEX_HOME and HOME, no proxy reachable, and a loopback mock Responses provider (127.0.0.1) answering each prompt with one tool call: the first launch shows the folder trust question and the hook review (6 hooks, reviewed with `t`); later launches, with the approval stored, show no review again: an `exec_command` with `sandbox_permissions: require_escalated` (frame-approve-command), an `apply_patch` under `-s read-only` (frame-approve-patch) and `request_user_input` in /plan mode (frame-plan-question*; the model picker is /model). Keys are those typed since the launch the screen was taken in; the paths shown are the scratch ones. States plan-mode-idle and default-mode-idle (captured 2026-10-05 from Codex 0.160.0, issue launch modes): the TUI after a turn answered by a loopback mock provider, launched with `-m gpt-5` in a scratch HOME and CODEX_HOME, Plan mode (`/plan Reply with OK` typed, Plan mode's footer `Plan mode` in magenta and the history line `Model changed to gpt-5 medium for Plan mode.`) and default mode (footer `gpt-5 default`, the start banner animation). Taken with tmux `capture-pane -e -p` in a 120x40 window, fed through Gluon's screen model; tmux gives no cursor, so it is recorded at the empty composer (two columns past its `›`); no OSC 11 answer, so no shading. Their `keys` are empty: nothing was typed in the default one, and the plan one was typed by the capture's driver, not by a key sequence replayed here. Base states (idle … new) re-captured from 0.162.1 (2026-10-10) the same way (config.toml: provider at 127.0.0.1:9, the project trusted), HOME a scratch directory too, one fresh launch each, OSC 11 answered as a black terminal (so the composer's shading differs from the 0.159.3 captures'). 0.162 starts a managed app-server daemon first: keys typed before the footer shows are lost, so each capture waits for it; each launch's daemon was stopped after it. The other states keep their capture's version.
